description: After a synthetic T, the written route predicts its suffix s only through productions that can read. So s → B reads the original B and c is a second reading, while the empty alternative of s, whose tag term would be an error over the empty span, is never evaluated (engine §7.4).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T] B
%rule b A [+T] [+T] B
%rule c A [+T s]
%rule s ε <tag(text($))> | B
